service_owners.description: List of system users allowed to own the oddjob D-Bus service.

allowed_groups.description: Groups whose members may access oddjob D-Bus methods.

name.description: Group name (must exist on the system)

service_exec.description: Absolute path to the oddjob daemon executable.

service_args.description: List of command-line arguments passed to the oddjobd executable.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs the daemon will run concurrently.

max_jobs_per_user.description: Maximum number of jobs allowed per user.

job_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a job is considered failed; 0 disables timeout.

enable_syslog.description: If true, log messages to the system syslog.

helper_dir.description: Directory containing helper scripts executed by oddjob.
